label: Ogmios system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses an Ogmios locus represented by a VCA0308 profile that can protect bacteria from bacteriophage infection.
observations: Ogmios branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual VCA0308 genes, VCA0308 proteins, DefenseFinder HMM profiles, predicted source-database rows naming one Ogmios locus, unresolved Ogmios trigger or effector activities, and other phage defense systems.
